newsitem.title: CANADA: Cameco drops on negative brokerage report.
newsitem.headline: Cameco drops on negative brokerage report.

text.p: Shares in Cameco Corp dropped on the Toronto and Montreal Stock Exchanges on Thursday after a pessimistic report about the uranium company, analysts said.
Cameco was down 4.95 to 61.50 in Toronto and by 5.10 to 61.40 in Montreal in moderate volume.
The stock began falling after brokerage Nesbitt Burns issued a negative report on Cameco. Nesbitt confirmed issuing the report, but did not elaborate.
But the company looked strong in the long run, said analyst John Lydall at First Marathon Securities. "This is a company that continues to build, that's doing well" he said.
Cameco said on Wednesday it earned C$38.03 million or C$0.72 a share in the third quarter versus year earlier C$24.12 million or C$0.45 a share.
The company said on Monday that it agreed to buy Power Resources Inc, a U.S. uranium mining company, for US$105 million.
"We're talking about a company that is getting to an increasingly dominating position in an industry where excess inventories have been dramatically reduced over the last 10 years," Lydall said.
